_note: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every route below is unverified desk research from EVD-005. Distances, surfaces, lighting and the drawn lines are illustrative only and must be replaced with ground-checked values and real GPS traces. See ../../content/route-template.md

routes.name: Campus loop
routes.traffic: Pedestrian paths, a few service-road crossings
routes.summary: The obvious first run for anyone new to Keele. Wide lit walkways, no road running, and you are never far from a building if the weather turns.

routes.name: The track off Steeles
routes.start: Athletics track, north end of campus
routes.summary: Not a route so much as a place to do intervals. Measured, flat, and no crossings to break your rhythm. Included for anyone training rather than exploring.

routes.name: Finch Hydro Corridor, eastbound
routes.start: Corridor trail entrance south of campus
routes.traffic: Shared with cyclists, a few road crossings
routes.summary: Paved multi-use trail running east toward G. Ross Lord Park. Straight, uninterrupted, and easy to cut short at any point since you simply turn around.

routes.name: Black Creek Parkland
routes.start: Trail entrance west of Sentinel Road
routes.summary: Wooded trail along the creek, and the closest thing to getting out of the city without leaving it. Softer underfoot than anything on campus.

routes.name: South to Derrydowns and Northwood
routes.traffic: Park paths with road crossings between parks
routes.summary: The longer ravine option, linking the creek trail south through two parks. The distance run when you want one, with a transit ride home at the end.

routes.name: Downsview Park
routes.summary: Wide open parkland further out, worth the trip when campus feels small. Big skies and long sightlines, which some runners like and others find exposed.
